selection.manualWait: The user’s manually extended wait has been preserved.
selection.predictionBeyondBudget: The historical arrival window exceeds the wait limit. Choose a currently eligible candidate without exhausting the budget; the quality target stays unchanged.
selection.predictionElapsed: The historical arrival window has ended. Recheck currently eligible candidates without restarting the timer.
selection.predictionSupported: Release delays for earlier independent episodes in this season support waiting. If the target release is still unavailable at the deadline, choose a currently eligible candidate.
selection.publishedAnchor: Timing starts from the earliest site publication time of a matching release. Mirrors, packs and new subscriptions do not restart the timer.
selection.unknownPublication: The publication time is unknown. Observe once within a fixed limit; the current discovery time is not treated as the publication time.
selection.subtitlesExpired: The wait has ended, but no release has subtitles or audio you understand. The original will not download automatically; a suitable release will be selected as soon as it appears.
selection.subtitlesWaiting: None of the releases found has subtitles or audio you understand. Waiting for a subtitled release.

health.noSites: No active release sites; subscriptions cannot find releases
health.brokenSites: All configured sites are unavailable (verification failed or disabled); subscriptions cannot find releases
health.rootIssue: The media library has no root path and cannot import automatically
health.diskPending: The hardlink filesystem check is temporarily unavailable
health.watchIssue: Directory watch is inactive; imports may be delayed
health.activeSites: {count, plural, one {# active site connected} other {# active sites connected}}
health.watchActive: The source directory is watched in real time and processed as soon as downloads finish
health.watchInactive: The source directory is not watched in real time (watchdog is missing or the directory is unavailable). Hourly fallback scans can still import files, with a delay.
health.downloaderDetail: Subscriptions can record what you want, but cannot download it.
health.mappingIssue: Path mappings for downloader “{name}” do not cover the media library directories
health.mappingDetail: Download directories for {count, plural, one {# library are} other {# libraries are}} outside the mapped paths. They share one cause: fix it once, without configuring every library. Dispatch is blocked until then; jobs are retained and retry automatically after the fix.
health.watchStaging: Send to import-watch directory {base}; completed downloads are organized into {staging} and recorded after external transfer to a library root
health.watchImport: Send to import-watch directory {base}; completed downloads are organized and imported automatically
health.noDownloader: No active default downloader; subscriptions can record requests but cannot download
health.noRoot: The library has no root path. Downloads go to the downloader’s default directory and will not import automatically.
health.diskUnavailable: A directory is unavailable ({source} or the {anchor} is unmounted). Mount it and run the check again.
health.sameDisk: The source directory and {anchor} are on the same filesystem; hardlinks use no extra space
health.differentDisk: The source directory and {target} are on different filesystems. Hardlinks will fail; change the import-watch strategy to Copy or adjust your storage layout.
health.directImport: Download directly into library root {base}; library scans record completed downloads automatically
health.mappingReady: The download directory is covered by the path mappings of “{name}”
health.mappingMissing: Directory {base} is outside the path mappings of downloader “{name}”, so dispatch will be blocked. Choose one fix: ① Add a path mapping. Mappings cover directory prefixes; map the common parent (local {anchor} → its path as seen by the downloader; use the same path on both sides if accessible) to cover all libraries below it. ② Add an automatic-routing import-watch rule for the library. Dispatch then uses a separate download directory, so mappings only need to cover that directory, regardless of how many libraries you have.
health.sitesWhy: Subscriptions begin with site searches. Without an active site, no releases can be found.
health.sitesSteps: Open Release sites to connect a site or repair its login session (for example, update its cookie).
health.downloaderFix: Connect a downloader and set it as default
health.downloaderWhy: Releases are sent to qBittorrent or Transmission for downloading.
health.downloaderSteps: Add an instance in Downloaders, verify its connection and set it as default.
health.mappingFix: Add one common parent path mapping (smallest change)
health.mappingWhy: Mappings cover directory prefixes. One mapping for the common parent covers all libraries below it. Use this when the downloader can access library directories and downloads may go directly into the library.
health.mappingSteps: Add a mapping: local path {anchor} → its path as seen by the downloader. If the downloader sees the same path, enter it on both sides.
health.watchFix: Use import watch (separate downloads from libraries)
health.watchWhy: Downloads go to a separate directory, so mappings only need to cover that directory, regardless of how many libraries you have. Completed files are hardlinked or copied into the library. Source files keep seeding, and removing a torrent keeps the library copy. Recommended for private trackers.
health.watchSteps: Create one automatic-routing rule for each of these types: {kinds}. Use the downloader’s download directory as the source; it must be outside all media library roots.
health.stagingNarrative: Matching releases are sent to {base}, then identified, renamed and {strategy, select, hardlink {hardlinked} other {copied}} to {target}. Your tools handle external transfer.{hasRoot, select, yes { Files are scanned and recorded when they appear in {root}.} other { This library has no root path, so returned files cannot be recorded.}}
health.watchNoRootNarrative: Releases are sent to import-watch directory {base}, but the library has no root path, so completed downloads cannot be imported.
health.watchNarrative: Matching releases are sent to {base}. Completed files are identified and {strategy, select, hardlink {hardlinked into “Title (Year)” under {root}. Source files remain in the download directory for seeding; removing a torrent keeps the library copy.} other {copied into “Title (Year)” under {root}. Source files remain in the download directory.}}
health.directNarrative: Matching releases download directly into a “Title (Year)” directory under {base}. Completed files are already in the library and recorded automatically by scans.
health.noRootNarrative: The library has no root path. Downloads go to the downloader’s default directory and will not import automatically.
